title: James H NDE 3213
content: My car plunged over an eighty feet cliff at 10:00 pm in February with temperatures well below freezing. Not sure how long I was trapped in the car, but after freeing myself, I began a six mile walk to get help. I had suffered a broken neck, back, separated both shoulders, punctured my stomach and spleen, and lost an ear. During the entire walk for help, I did not once feel that I would not make it. I just kept walking and climbing, driven to survive. I reached a farm house at 7:00 am the next morning and an ambulance was soon there. Once in the ambulance and the emergency medical technician began to work on me, I just stopped breathing. I felt no desire nor need to breathe. I could see and hear the emergency medical technician telling me to breath but I could not, nor did I want to, answer. I then just closed my eyes for a second and I was gone. I had never felt so alive and complete. There was no pain or discomfort. I was totally at peace. My spirit or energy was floating through what looked like a heavy snow fall. Large flakes or bits of light were gentle falling around me. I was floating towards a very warm soft light. I possessed the certain knowledge that once I reached the light I would be whole or complete - that this was the only place I belonged. Just as I reached the light, I encountered a force or an energy that repelled me away. At that instance, I opened my eyes and felt the emergency medical technician force a plastic tube down my throat, forcing me to breathe. I did not come back willingly or by choice.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death . Severe trauma due to auto accident and exposure.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal Through the entire event.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Had no concept of up, down, or directions, floating free of gravitation.
elements.Did your vision differ in any way from n: It was more of an awareness of the surroundings, not like normal vision.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Very gentle warm light, much like the light from a fireplace as seen through a cabin window from the outside.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm was floating in descinding bit of light like snow flakes
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Total bliss - peace everything that is wonderful.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes Knew that I belonged here, that this was very right and in order with the universe.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I learned that you need not fear death. That you should not live your life being scare of death.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Was in a drug induced coma in intensive care unit for several days and did not recall experience until several weeks later - not much reaction one way or another.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes At the age of five or six I had a high fever of 104 degrees for several days. I was placed in tub of ice water. Then placed in blankets with hot water bottles. This was at home on the ranch. I lost consciousness and went to what I called the valley of the dead. Saw many dead relatives and others. They were climbing this gentle mountain. Not working hard just steady and with little effort. There was a stream and I would sit and talk with them. They always told me to tell their loved ones not to worry or grieve anymore for them, that they were just fine. I never told anyone of this. Throughout my life anytime, I would get a high fever I would return and see recently dead people. I saw and talked to my dad, grandfather, many aunts and uncles. This experience was totally different from the auto crash.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real. There was no doubt that it was real, I still felt the same certainty of the knowledge that I possessed during the event.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real. Nothing has changed, still feel the certainty.
